intro: This page lists MBA colleges in Bangalore where the recorded average package exceeds the recorded fee. It is a way to scan the best MBA colleges in Bangalore where average package exceeds fees, not a promise for the next batch.
We currently show {{count}} published colleges on this filter. Read the programme name and the placement year, because some figures in our file are several years old.
listLead: The first cards include IBS Bengaluru, MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Alliance University and several private MBA campuses in the city. Some cards show a specialised or global programme, so compare the official MBA fee, not only the title on the card.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. The median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, with averages ranging from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.
Placement years in our file run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}, so an older year should be read as history. CAT is the exam most often linked here.
Use the list of top MBA colleges in Bangalore 2026 as a shortlist, then compare the official fee notice and placement report.
firstCollegesLead: IBS Bengaluru is listed first, with a recorded MBA Finance fee of ₹6.53 lakh and a 2022 average package of ₹9 lakh, plus a highest of ₹53 lakh. Those placement figures are from 2022, not a current promise.
Alliance University’s card shows a Global MBA at ₹2.25 lakh, which may not be the flagship MBA fee. Some later cards have placement years of 2020 or 2021, so check the latest official report.

compare.heading: How to compare the best MBA colleges in Bangalore where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: A gap on the card can shrink once you use the current fee and the current placement year. Older averages should not be treated as this year’s result.
Before you apply, check these points:
bullets: Whether the card shows the flagship MBA or a specialised or global programme.
The year of the placement report, especially where our records go back to 2020 or 2021.
Whether the fee is for one year or the full two-year programme.
The entrance test (CAT is the most common link here) and the cut-off for your category.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Bangalore are on this value list?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MBA colleges in Bangalore currently meet this filter in our records, meaning the recorded average package is higher than the recorded fee for the programme on the card.

faqs.question: Does this mean the average salary will pay back the fee?
faqs.answer: No, the comparison uses historical package and fee figures in our file, and it does not include hostel or personal costs, so it is not a guarantee of a financial return.

faqs.question: Why are some placement years as old as 2020?
faqs.answer: Those are the latest years we hold for those programmes, not necessarily the latest official report, so confirm the current placement document before you rely on a number.

faqs.question: What is a typical fee and average package here?
faqs.answer: The median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages ranging from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.

faqs.question: Which exam do these colleges accept?
faqs.answer: CAT is the exam most often linked here, with some colleges also linked to ATMA or MAT. Confirm the current process on the official admission page.
